protocol.scope: Exactly 781 sign-normalized words on the eleven certified u11 basis sections, support at most three, coefficients +/-1. Keep only P.O=2 and use explicit known vertical curves for exact generic-MW upper bounds. No rootless frames, other word heights or other parent. At most eight first roster rows with bound>11 and quadratic finite pole denominator may compile under separate immutable row outputs; no refill after a failed compilation. No point searches.

admission.ordering: First eight rows of the frozen descending bound/word/component roster. All must pass finite-pole preparation; no refill.

geometry.scope: Exact birational chord inverse, rational quartic sections, Jacobian invariants and complete minimal semistable fibre decomposition. Picard ranks18/19 transport through the birational K3 identification and the rational quartic section; Shioda-Tate yields exact rational and geometric generic ranks. Nine presentations, not claimed pairwise inequivalent. No rational point search or high-rank addition.
